subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close/adopt the conflicting linked fork PR and allow a fresh narrow fix against the active Telegram approval runtime?
rationale: Automation should not queue a replacement while a GitHub closing PR is still open, but that PR is conflicting and targets the removed handler path rather than current `main`.

options.title: Close or replace the linked fork PR
options.body: Treat the fork PR as obsolete, then allow a fresh narrow fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt the fork manually
options.body: A maintainer can salvage the useful idea by moving it to the active runtime and dropping unrelated stale docs/handler changes.

options.title: Keep waiting on the fork
options.body: Leave this issue blocked on the conflicting fork PR, accepting that no current-main fix path is available yet.

recommendation.title: Close or replace the linked fork PR
recommendation.body: Treat the fork PR as obsolete, then allow a fresh narrow fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The active runtime and shared final-action lifecycle were introduced in their approval lifecycle refactor, so they are the strongest code-history routing candidate for the fix shape.
